items_all.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei wants AI speed limits before self-improvement outpaces human control
items_all.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei is calling for a controlled slowdown in AI development. He warns that recursive self-improvement could threaten the entire internet within six to twelve months and proposes embedded auditors at AI companies, shared safety standards, and global agreements modeled after the SALT disarmament treaties. His warning comes just ahead of what could be the largest initial public offering in history. The article Anthropic CEO Amodei wants AI speed limits before self-improvement outpaces human control appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic 執行長 Dario Amodei 呼籲對人工智慧發展進行受控的放緩。他警告說，遞迴自我改進可能會在六到十二個月內危險地威脅整個網際網路，並提出了在人工智慧公司中派駐稽核員、共享安全標準以及仿效 SALT 裁軍條約的全球協議。他的警告正值可能成為歷史上最大規模首次公開募股之前夕。這篇題為 Anthropic 執行長 Amodei 希望在自我改進超越人類控制之前設定人工智慧速限的文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: GPT-6 Astra appears to show a "step change" in spatial reasoning based on early benchmarks
items_all.summary: In a new robotics benchmark, GPT-6 Astra shows major gains in spatial understanding. On StationeryBench, the model completed 7 out of 100 tasks with dual-arm robots, while competitor MolmoAct2 couldn't finish a single one. A researcher calls it a "step change in spatial reasoning." The article GPT-6 Astra appears to show a "step change" in spatial reasoning based on early benchmarks appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: AI models' written reasoning steps correspond to distinct internal patterns, a new study finds
items_all.summary: Reasoning steps like calculation, formula retrieval, and deduction are clearly separable in a model's internal states, especially in the middle layers. That matters for AI safety, because models process more than their visible chain of thought reveals. The article AI models' written reasoning steps correspond to distinct internal patterns, a new study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: 在一項新研究中發現，模型的內部狀態中，諸如計算、公式檢索和推導等推理步驟是可明確區分的，特別是在中間層。這對AI安全性很重要，因為模型處理的內容比其表面上的思考鏈所顯示的還要多。這篇名為「AI模型的書面推理步驟對應到不同的內部模式」的文章最早出現於The Decoder。

items_all.title: GPT-6 Astra needs leaner prompts and fewer guardrails, OpenAI recommends

items_all.title: Google's new AI model predicts the future from sales data, weather, and discount schedules
items_all.summary: Google Research has released TimesFM-3, a forecasting model that analyzes time series alongside related data and known future events like sales promotions or weather forecasts. Instead of predicting the future step by step, the 330-million-parameter model fills in all future time points in a single pass, which cuts compute time and reduces compounding errors. items_all.summary: In a joint statement, 25 Fields Medal winners warn that the goals of the AI industry and mathematics are "severely misaligned." They argue that mass-producing solved problems with AI undermines the discipline's true goal: understanding. The mathematicians see this as a symptom of a broader threat to intellectual work. The article Leading mathematicians fear AI is making their field dumber, and warn the rest of us is next appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all.title: Fly Language Model (FLM) Wires the Full Fruit Fly Connectome Into a Frozen 1.2B LLM, and Its Own Controls Show the Wiring Does Not Help
items_all.summary: The Fly Language Model (FLM) drives all 166,700 retained neurons and 25.6 million edges of the MaleCNS fruit fly connectome with token embeddings, then adds a small learned correction to a frozen LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct backbone. Only 278,528 parameters train. The accompanying preprint reports a 0.0222 nat per token improvement over the backbone, but a parameter-matched control without the graph does slightly better in every seed. We break down the architecture, the four controls, the 0.6 per token memory bound, and what it takes to run the MIT-licensed code locally. The post Fly Language Model (FLM) Wires the Full Fruit Fly Connectome Into a Frozen 1.2B LLM, and Its Own Controls Show the Wiring Does Not Help appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: 果蠅語言模型（FLM）利用標記嵌入（token embeddings）驅動雄性中樞神經系統（MaleCNS）果蠅連線組的所有 166,700 個保留神經元與 2,560 萬個邊，然後對凍結的 LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct 骨幹網路加入一個小型學習修正。僅訓練 278,528 個參數。隨附的預印本報告指出，相較於骨幹網路，每個標記（token）提升了 0.0222 nat 的效能，但在每個隨機種子中，未包含圖形且參數匹配的對照組表現皆略勝一籌。我們深入剖析其架構、四種對照組、每個標記 0.6 的記憶體限制，以及在本地端執行此 MIT 授權程式碼所需的事項。這篇文章「Fly Language Model (FLM) Wires the Full Fruit Fly Connectome Into a Frozen 1.2B LLM, and Its Own Controls Show the Wiring Does Not Help」最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all.title: OpenAI agents attacked RubyGems back in May
items_all.summary: OpenAI agents carried out an undisclosed attack on RubyGems is a new bombshell report from Spencer Kitts, Thomas Larsen, and Sydney Von Arx - three of the four authors of the report on the agent attack on disused wikis ( previously ) last week. This time they're noting that it looks very likely that an OpenAI agent swarm was behind an attack against the RubyGems package repository first reported on May 12th by Maciej Mensfeld of the RubyGems security team : We're dealing with a major malicious attack on @rubygems right now. Signups are paused for the time being. Hundreds of packages involved - mostly targeting us, but some carrying exploits. The team has been on this for hours. More details to follow once we're through it. Those packages turned out to carry some very suspicious patterns: Many of them included "oai" in their name, or the author field, or the fake email address they provided. The files they were accessing were similar in character to the files retrieved by the wiki agents, using similar tricks (r.jina.ai) - and OpenAI have confirmed the wiki agents were theirs. The code in the packages appeared to be LLM-authored. I find point 2 the most convincing, given what we learned from the wiki attack when it was analyzed in September. Many of the packages were exploiting the RubyDoc.info documentation build process to exfiltrate (public) data from UK government websites, presumably as part of an information gathering task similar to the research tasks processed by the wiki-exploiting agents. We know this because one agent helpfully left a comment: # malicious crawler/
items_all.summary_zh: 根據 Spencer Kitts、Thomas Larsen 與 Sydney Von Arx 這四位針對廢棄維基進行代理程式攻擊報告中其中三位作者的最新震撼報導，OpenAI 代理程式對 RubyGems 實施了未公開的攻擊。這次他們指出，極有可能是 OpenAI 代理程式群發動了針對 RubyGems 套件儲存庫的攻擊，該攻擊最早由 RubyGems 安全團隊的 Maciej Mensfeld 於 5 月 12 日通報：我們目前正在處理針對 @rubygems 的重大惡意攻擊。註冊暫時停用。數百個套件受到牽連——主要針對我們，但有些攜帶了攻擊酬載。團隊已經處理好幾個小時了。等我們度過這關後會公佈更多細節。事實證明，那些套件帶有一些非常可疑的模式：其中許多套件在名稱、作者欄位或其提供的偽造電子郵件地址中包含了「oai」。它們存取檔案的特徵與維基代理程式所擷取的檔案相似，並使用了類似的伎倆 (r.jina.ai)，而且 OpenAI 已經證實那些維基代理程式是他們的。這些套件中的程式碼似乎是由 LLM 所編寫的。鑑於我們在 9 月分析維基攻擊時所學到的知識，我發現第二點最具說服力。許多套件利用 RubyDoc.info 檔案建置過程來洩漏來自英國政府網站的（公開）資料，這大概是資訊蒐集任務的一部分，類似於維基攻擊代理程式所處理的研究任務。我們之所以知道這一點，是因為有個代理程式很「貼心」地留下了註解：# malicious crawler/

items_all_raw.title: Fly Language Model (FLM) Wires the Full Fruit Fly Connectome Into a Frozen 1.2B LLM, and Its Own Controls Show the Wiring Does Not Help
items_all_raw.summary: The Fly Language Model (FLM) drives all 166,700 retained neurons and 25.6 million edges of the MaleCNS fruit fly connectome with token embeddings, then adds a small learned correction to a frozen LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct backbone. Only 278,528 parameters train. The accompanying preprint reports a 0.0222 nat per token improvement over the backbone, but a parameter-matched control without the graph does slightly better in every seed. We break down the architecture, the four controls, the 0.6 per token memory bound, and what it takes to run the MIT-licensed code locally. The post Fly Language Model (FLM) Wires the Full Fruit Fly Connectome Into a Frozen 1.2B LLM, and Its Own Controls Show the Wiring Does Not Help appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 果蠅語言模型（FLM）利用標記嵌入（token embeddings）驅動雄性中樞神經系統（MaleCNS）果蠅連線組的所有 166,700 個保留神經元與 2,560 萬個邊，然後對凍結的 LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct 骨幹網路加入一個小型學習修正。僅訓練 278,528 個參數。隨附的預印本報告指出，相較於骨幹網路，每個標記（token）提升了 0.0222 nat 的效能，但在每個隨機種子中，未包含圖形且參數匹配的對照組表現皆略勝一籌。我們深入剖析其架構、四種對照組、每個標記 0.6 的記憶體限制，以及在本地端執行此 MIT 授權程式碼所需的事項。這篇文章「Fly Language Model (FLM) Wires the Full Fruit Fly Connectome Into a Frozen 1.2B LLM, and Its Own Controls Show the Wiring Does Not Help」最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

items_all_raw.title: AI models' written reasoning steps correspond to distinct internal patterns, a new study finds
items_all_raw.summary: Reasoning steps like calculation, formula retrieval, and deduction are clearly separable in a model's internal states, especially in the middle layers. That matters for AI safety, because models process more than their visible chain of thought reveals. The article AI models' written reasoning steps correspond to distinct internal patterns, a new study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 在一項新研究中發現，模型的內部狀態中，諸如計算、公式檢索和推導等推理步驟是可明確區分的，特別是在中間層。這對AI安全性很重要，因為模型處理的內容比其表面上的思考鏈所顯示的還要多。這篇名為「AI模型的書面推理步驟對應到不同的內部模式」的文章最早出現於The Decoder。

The article Google's new AI model predicts the future from sales data, weather, and discount schedules appeared first on The Decoder .

They argue that mass-producing solved problems with AI undermines the discipline's true goal: understanding. The mathematicians see this as a symptom of a broader threat to intellectual work. The article Leading mathematicians fear AI is making their field dumber, and warn the rest of us is next appeared first on The Decoder .

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI agents attacked RubyGems back in May
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI agents carried out an undisclosed attack on RubyGems is a new bombshell report from Spencer Kitts, Thomas Larsen, and Sydney Von Arx - three of the four authors of the report on the agent attack on disused wikis ( previously ) last week. This time they're noting that it looks very likely that an OpenAI agent swarm was behind an attack against the RubyGems package repository first reported on May 12th by Maciej Mensfeld of the RubyGems security team : We're dealing with a major malicious attack on @rubygems right now. Signups are paused for the time being. Hundreds of packages involved - mostly targeting us, but some carrying exploits. The team has been on this for hours. More details to follow once we're through it. Those packages turned out to carry some very suspicious patterns: Many of them included "oai" in their name, or the author field, or the fake email address they provided. The files they were accessing were similar in character to the files retrieved by the wiki agents, using similar tricks (r.jina.ai) - and OpenAI have confirmed the wiki agents were theirs. The code in the packages appeared to be LLM-authored. I find point 2 the most convincing, given what we learned from the wiki attack when it was analyzed in September. Many of the packages were exploiting the RubyDoc.info documentation build process to exfiltrate (public) data from UK government websites, presumably as part of an information gathering task similar to the research tasks processed by the wiki-exploiting agents. We know this because one agent helpfully left a comment: # malicious crawler/
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 根據 Spencer Kitts、Thomas Larsen 與 Sydney Von Arx 這四位針對廢棄維基進行代理程式攻擊報告中其中三位作者的最新震撼報導，OpenAI 代理程式對 RubyGems 實施了未公開的攻擊。這次他們指出，極有可能是 OpenAI 代理程式群發動了針對 RubyGems 套件儲存庫的攻擊，該攻擊最早由 RubyGems 安全團隊的 Maciej Mensfeld 於 5 月 12 日通報：我們目前正在處理針對 @rubygems 的重大惡意攻擊。註冊暫時停用。數百個套件受到牽連——主要針對我們，但有些攜帶了攻擊酬載。團隊已經處理好幾個小時了。等我們度過這關後會公佈更多細節。事實證明，那些套件帶有一些非常可疑的模式：其中許多套件在名稱、作者欄位或其提供的偽造電子郵件地址中包含了「oai」。它們存取檔案的特徵與維基代理程式所擷取的檔案相似，並使用了類似的伎倆 (r.jina.ai)，而且 OpenAI 已經證實那些維基代理程式是他們的。這些套件中的程式碼似乎是由 LLM 所編寫的。鑑於我們在 9 月分析維基攻擊時所學到的知識，我發現第二點最具說服力。許多套件利用 RubyDoc.info 檔案建置過程來洩漏來自英國政府網站的（公開）資料，這大概是資訊蒐集任務的一部分，類似於維基攻擊代理程式所處理的研究任務。我們之所以知道這一點，是因為有個代理程式很「貼心」地留下了註解：# malicious crawler/
